concepts.gloss_en: His (blessed) glory was revealed — the revelation (hitgalut) of God's glory

reason_for_human: All three occurrences are the identical verbal phrase נתגלה כבודו ('His glory is revealed') from the same passage in LM II:71, all expressing that God's glory is revealed/multiplied through man and procreation. The added יתברך is just the standard divine epithet, not a different word or concept. Clean single-concept merge.
